briefings.tldr: Dassault Systèmes is transitioning its 3DEXPERIENCE platform from a SaaS model to an "Agent-as-a-Service" architecture, utilizing physics-grounded "Industry World Models" and AI virtual companions to automate complex industrial design, simulation, and manufacturing processes.
